hints.title: Permutation Construction
hints.text: When appending the i-th element (0-indexed) into a permutation of length i, it can contribute any number of new inversions from 0 to i.

hints.title: DP State with Constraints
hints.text: Let dp[k] be the number of permutations with k inversions. If a requirement is specified for index i, zero out all dp[k] where k does not equal the required count.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Optimization
hints.text: Transitions dp_next[k] = sum_{j=0}^i dp[k - j] can be calculated in O(1) per state using running prefix sums.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Prefix sum DP transitions run in O(1) per inversion state.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all n! permutations causes factorial timeout.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model the Mahonian distribution DP with prefix sum acceleration and constraint pruning.
